proposed_comments.title: Prevent losing activation callbacks from reclaiming focus

confidence.rationale: The content-loaded callback and fallback timer can both complete after activation begins, allowing a stale callback to reactivate the window after another path has won.

proposed_comments.body:
### Prevent losing activation callbacks from reclaiming focus

**Severity:** `medium`

The content-loaded and fallback activation paths can both outlive the activation attempt. Please ensure the losing callback is invalidated before it can call `Activate()` or reclaim focus after the winning path has completed. Add a focused race test that invokes both callbacks in either order and verifies only the winner can show or focus the Settings window.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The correction spans multiple current-diff regions and requires coordinated lifecycle or cleanup behavior, so no single safe apply-ready inline replacement exists.

proposed_comments.title: Track the benchmarked Settings instance instead of any Settings process

confidence.rationale: Hidden OOBE or other Settings processes can satisfy the current process checks and cause cleanup to restore the wrong pre-existing runner state.

proposed_comments.body:
### Track the benchmarked Settings instance explicitly

**Severity:** `medium`

The benchmark currently treats any matching Settings process as the launched window, which can confuse a hidden OOBE/What's New process with the instance under test and later restore the wrong runner state. Please capture the launched process/window identity and the exact pre-existing visible Settings instances, then use those identities for readiness checks and cleanup rather than process-name presence.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The correction spans multiple current-diff regions and requires coordinated lifecycle or cleanup behavior, so no single safe apply-ready inline replacement exists.

proposed_comments.title: Restore stopped runners when Settings launch fails

confidence.rationale: The benchmark stops existing runners before launch, but the launch-failure path can exit without restoring them.

proposed_comments.body:
### Restore prior runners on launch failure

**Severity:** `medium`

If launching Settings fails after the benchmark stops existing PowerToys runners, the failure path can leave the user's prior runners stopped. Please put runner restoration in failure-safe cleanup that executes for launch errors as well as successful measurements, while preserving which runner instances were originally active.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The correction spans multiple current-diff regions and requires coordinated lifecycle or cleanup behavior, so no single safe apply-ready inline replacement exists.
